head: 7f2fb48b2e4f05596c758610041ce915633bf3e1
hypothesis: gate-trailer.cjs parsed argv in two passes that each held a hole — argv.indexOf() took the FIRST occurrence, so a duplicate flag exited 0 with the later value dropped in silence (fail-safe for the three value-checked keys, but NOT for --repo, whose value nothing validates, so a caller whose second --repo is the intended one writes the verdict onto a same-numbered PR in another repository), while the separate i += 2 scan encoded 'every flag takes one value' in a bare literal and already mis-diagnosed a missing value by naming the NEXT flag's value; both are now one left-to-right pass that refuses duplicates and blames the flag actually missing its value, and pr-sentinel.md's snippet now carries --repo, pinned.

head: 8566d0f84be0ed69e4e3bed43db71746abbad772

reason: out-of-scope: the only correct fix for the CI failure is one line in tests/smoke/docs-smoke.sh:189 (const MECHANICAL = new Set(['undraft','merge']) needs 'base-merge'), and that file is NOT in 24-06-PLAN.md's files_modified (the plan declared tests/smoke/sentinel-smoke.sh only). The ticket's code is correct and its own suites are green (sentinel 77/0, front 96/0, reviewers 11/0, log-event 11/0, sentinel-smoke 51/0); the docs contract has simply never heard of the base-merge duty. Every in-scope alternative was weighed and is wrong: removing base-merge from ACTIONABLE makes a dead-base PR vanish from all four duty buckets and report the guard 'clear' (the exact hole ADR-002 D4 closes); folding it into the merge action cannot reach the case, because a BEHIND base blocks a PR while it is still draft and in CI, long before merge-eligibility, and duty deliberately places base-merge ahead of threads and pending CI; renaming it to ci-fix breaks the plan's acceptance criterion, D4's naming, and spends the ticket's repair budget on a mechanical merge (which is why log-event.cjs gained base_merge as a NON-attempt event). Needs a human decision: either widen 24-06's files_modified to include tests/smoke/docs-smoke.sh, or add a third docs-smoke category for duty actions that dispatch under a declared role alias (base-merge is a hybrid: base-merge.cjs does the work, but fix-round.mjs needsBaseMerge can dispatch a fixer for an in-scope conflict, resolving at the ci-fix tier).
